description: This Dart file defines the AppState class, which manages the application's global state including authentication token, login status, and initialization status. It uses SharedPreferences for persistence and ChangeNotifier for state updates, suitable for Flutter applications.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A class that manages application-wide state related to authentication and UI flags, providing methods for initialization, setting tokens, and logging out.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the AppState by loading persisted auth token from shared preferences.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores the provided authentication token persistently and updates the state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the authentication token from the state and persistent storage.
